caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Your phone doesn't see your amazing photos like you do! It's all about secret number grids.

Here's the mind-blowing breakdown:
🔹 When you snap a photo, your phone saves a massive grid of numbers.
🔹 Each tiny square (pixel) has numbers for its exact color and brightness.
🔹 Your phone uses these millions of numerical codes to recreate the image.
🔹 It's like an incredibly detailed digital paint-by-numbers masterpiece!
